content:
# Full graded eval after skill, schema, review, or harness land on main.
# Needs repo secret CURSOR_API_KEY. Skips (does not fail) when that secret is unset.
# Optional repo secret MUSE_CODE_API_KEY installs the Muse Code CLI and arms
# --cursor-fallback: when Cursor errors (usage limits included), roles move to Muse.
# Event-driven: path filter on main, plus workflow_dispatch. Not a cron.

name: Eval suite

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "skills-next/comprehende/**"
      - "src/schema/**"
      - "src/review/**"
      - "scripts/eval/**"
      - "eval/cases/**"
      - ".github/workflows/eval.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: eval-suite
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  eval:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/setup@v2
        with:
          runtime: node@24
          cache: true
          install: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Install Muse Code (Cursor fallback)
        if: secrets.MUSE_CODE_API_KEY != ''
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p ~/.local/bin
          curl -fsSL https://api.meta.ai/muse-launcher.sh -o ~/.local/bin/muse
          chmod +x ~/.local/bin/muse
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          MUSE_LAUNCHER_INSTALL=1 ~/.local/bin/muse
          ~/.local/bin/muse --version
      - name: Full graded eval
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
          MUSE_CODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MUSE_CODE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${CURSOR_API_KEY}" ]; then
            echo "Repo secret CURSOR_API_KEY is not set. Skipping the full graded suite."
            echo "Add it under Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions."
            echo "::warning::CURSOR_API_KEY secret missing; full eval skipped"
            exit 0
          fi
          unset GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN
          flags="--json"
          if [ -n "${MUSE_CODE_API_KEY}" ] && command -v muse >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            flags="$flags --cursor-fallback"
          else
            echo "::warning::Muse fallback unavailable (needs the MUSE_CODE_API_KEY secret and the muse CLI); cursor-only run"
          fi
          # Word-split on purpose: flags holds separate argv words.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2086
          pnpm eval -- $flags
      - name: Upload eval run
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: eval-run
          path: eval/runs
          if-no-files-found: ignore
